shared_elements: shallow relief carving organised in horizontal registers/bands
rows of repeated small motifs or sign-like forms
possible schematic figures/creatures in a lower register
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry low relief divided into horizontal registers containing rows of small repeated sign-like or figural motifs, which is a very generic organising device. A shows a fully developed figural scene — a rayed disc above, large striding figures with tall crowns adoring an offering stand laden with goods, framed by dense columns of script — while B shows only two eroded bands of small rounded shapes and indistinct low forms with no comparable central scene, disc, or human figures.
